description: 국토교통부_(연속주제)_소하천_소하천구역 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토교통부. 소하천의 형상과 기능을 유지하고 있는 토지의 구역으로 소하천부속물이 설치된 토지의 구역 또는 제방이 있는 곳은 그 제방으로부터 물이 흐르는 쪽의 토지의 구역 (소하천/소하천구역). Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토교통부. Its tags are 하천, 하천구역, 제방, 국토관리. It offers 1 resource(s) in shp. The portal shows 2026-08-24 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
